properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1022841
Incident Time: 2012-08-29 13:45:00
Nearest City: York, Pa, PA
Location: EAST MANCHESTER TOWNSHIP, YORK COUNTY, PENNSYLVANIA 305 RIVERVIEW ROAD MOUNT WOLF
Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: CHLORINE
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: THE YORK WATER COMPANY
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 40.055556, -76.645556 (Explicit)
Report Description
AT APPROXIMATELY 1345 HOURS ON THE AFTERNOON OF WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 29, 2012 A SMALL, YET UNKNOWN QUANTITY OF CHLORINE GAS WAS RELEASED FROM A CHLORINE CYLINDER LOCATED AT A WASTEWATER TREATMENT PLANT IN EAST MANCHESTER TOWNSHIP, YORK COUNTY, PA. EMERGENCY RESPONDERS AND LOCAL HAZMAT CREWS RESPONDED TO THE SITE. INCIDENT COMMANDER ISSUED A VOLUNTARY EVACUATION ORDER TO APPROXIMATELY 100 RESIDENTIAL UNITS IN THE AREA. ONE DAMAGED CHLORINE CYLINDER WAS PLACED INTO A SECONDARY CONTAINMENT STRUCTURE AND TRANSPORTED OFF SITE BY TRAINED, LICENSED PROFESSIONALS. AS A RESULT OF THE RELEASE, THREE COMPANY EMPLOYEES WERE TRANSPORTED TO A LOCAL MEDICAL FACILITY FOR OBSERVATION. TWO WERE RELEASED AT 2030 HOURS THAT EVENING, THE THIRD WAS RELEASED AT 1000 HOURS THE FOLLOWING DAY. NONE OF THE THREE SUSTAINED INJURY. TEMPORARY EVACUATION ORDER WAS LIFTED AT 1700 HOURS WITH NO ADDITIONAL DAMAGE TO PERSONNEL OR PROPERTY. CHLORINE GAS RELEASE DURATION WAS APPROXIMATELY 30 SECONDS.

properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 1038416 - Medium Affected: LAND - Suspected Responsible Party:
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1038416
Incident Time: 2013-02-13 07:00:00
Nearest City: Mount Vernon, WA
Location: TRUCK STOP 3216 HWY 99 SOUTH
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: PRILLED SULPHUR, CAS #7704-34-9
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party:
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 48.412957, -122.360385 (Approximated from ZIP)
Report Description
***WEB REPORT****HAD EARLY MORNING CASHIER CALL ME AT 7 AM TO SAY THAT THERE WAS A TRAIL OF A YELLOW SUBSTANCE AROUND THE PARKING LOT. ARRIVED AT SCENE AT 7:30 AM TO FIND 2 SUBSTANTIAL PILES OF SULFUR PELLETS CONNECTED BY A DOUBLE TRACK OF PELLETS. I HAD MY YARD GUY SHOVEL THE PILES INTO 4 55 GALLON DRUMS, AND PICKED UP ALL WE COULD, WHILE I REPORTED TO THE WASHINGTON DEPARTMENT OF ECOLOGY. WITH THEIR HELP, WE TRACKED DOWN THE MILL WHERE THE PRODUCT CAME FROM. I WENT THERE WITH A SAMPLE TO COMFIRM THAT IT WAS THEIR MATERIAL AND GOT THE MSDS ON THE SUBSTANCE (PRILLED SULPHUR, CAS #7704-34-9) AND GOT ASSURANCE THAT THEY WOULD TAKE THE 4 BARRELS OF PELLETS TO PUT BACK INTO THEIR STOCKPILE. THEY TOLD ME THAT THE MATERIAL WAS TRUCKED OUT LAST NIGHT HEADED FOR A CARROT FARMER IN EASTERN WASHINGTON. WASHINGTON DOE SAID THAT THIS PRODUCT WAS NOT HAZARDOUS, BUT THAT I SHOULD REPORT IT TO NRC. AT THIS TIME, THERE IS A SMALL FAINT TRAIL OF THE PRODUCT AROUND THE LOT, AND I AM WAITING TO HEAR FROM THE MILL WITH THE NAME OF THE TRUCKING COMPANY.

properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 936801
Incident Time: 2010-04-11 17:20:00
Nearest City: Bridgeport, CT
Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: HYDRAULIC OIL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: DERECKTOR SHIP YARD
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 125 gallons
DURING LAUNCH OF A 300' DRY DOCK, A D8 CATERPILLAR BULLDOZER WAS DRAGGED INTO THE BRIDGEPORT HARBOR INTO APPROXIMATELY 25' OF WATER. THE HARBOR MASTER CAME ON THE SCENE AND ALTHOUGH THERE IS APPROXIMATELY 90 GALLONS OF DIESEL FUEL IN THE FUEL TANK AND APPROXIMATELY 35 GALLONS OF HYDRAULIC OIL IN THE HYDRAULIC SYSTEM, NO OIL RELEASE WAS NOTED. THE HARBOR MASTER CONTACTED AND REPORTED TO THE USCG ON DERECKTOR SHIP YARD BEHALF. A SALVAGE COMPANY HAS BEEN CONTACTED AND WILL BE REMOVING THE DOZER AS SOON AS PRACTICABLE GIVEN THE REQUIREMENTS FOR STAGING EQUIPMENT FOR RETRIEVAL.

Suspected Responsible Party: DERECKTOR SHIP YARD
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 125 gallons
DURING LAUNCH OF A 300' DRY DOCK, A D8 CATERPILLAR BULLDOZER WAS DRAGGED INTO THE BRIDGEPORT HARBOR INTO APPROXIMATELY 25' OF WATER. THE HARBOR MASTER CAME ON THE SCENE AND ALTHOUGH THERE IS APPROXIMATELY 90 GALLONS OF DIESEL FUEL IN THE FUEL TANK AND APPROXIMATELY 35 GALLONS OF HYDRAULIC OIL IN THE HYDRAULIC SYSTEM, NO OIL RELEASE WAS NOTED. THE HARBOR MASTER CONTACTED AND REPORTED TO THE USCG ON DERECKTOR SHIP YARD BEHALF. A SALVAGE COMPANY HAS BEEN CONTACTED AND WILL BE REMOVING THE DOZER AS SOON AS PRACTICABLE GIVEN THE REQUIREMENTS FOR STAGING EQUIPMENT FOR RETRIEVAL.
